126395.synopsis:
She is Su Ran, the most respected and esteemed master of metaphysics—the favorite disciple of the grandmaster in the field.
After battling a toad demon for three hundred rounds and winning, her soul suddenly transmigrates into another world—into the body of a girl who fell into a sewer.
Oh my god, who’s life is worse than mine?
To make ends meet and have a meal every day, she starts live-streaming fortune telling.
 Three readings a day, five hundred per reading.
Su Ran: “Ice cream or dad? Which one do you choose?” Viewer: “Choose dad? Fine, then the ice cream is mine.”
A lucky baby: “Host, can you tell if the baby in my belly is a boy or a girl?” Su Ran’s expression suddenly changes: “Forget boy or girl—run for your life!”
A beautiful young lady, looking pale: “Host, I have anemia.” Su Ran clicks her tongue: “That’s not anemia, you’re being drained by a vampire!”
A newly rich man named “The God of Wealth’s Little Treasure”: “Host, I think I just dug up a zombie?” Su Ran sincerely remarks: “You’ve got great luck—go buy a lottery ticket!”
A handsome guy: “Host, there’s nothing for you to tell me.” Su Ran: “Nothing to tell? Your sister’s mango allergy almost killed her!”
…and so on.

138683.synopsis:
[System + No Identity Reveal + Divine Maiden Persona] After Jiang Wu was bound by the system, she was lured by the promise of wealth and taken by the system to a remote, unknown dynasty to complete her mission. Only then did she realize that she, a commoner, had to win over the emperor, empress, crown prince, princess, general, marquis, heir… Well, her targets included fathers and sons, husbands and wives, brothers and sisters. System, are you sure I won’t be torn apart by five horses?
“Host, believe in yourself. You are the chosen femme fatale.”
No, Jiang Wu thought expressionlessly. The script she’d been handed was more like a deadly path through mountains of knives and seas of fire.
However, after browsing the system’s shop, Jiang Wu realized it wasn’t entirely hopeless. In an era where imperial power reigned supreme, even selling refined salt could get her executed. As for beauty? Ha! For an ordinary person, possessing such looks would only invite a more gruesome death.
The Great Xuan Dynasty had just been established and was in a precarious state, with everything in disarray and countless restless opportunists lying in wait.
When Crown Prince Xie Zhao pursued a group of bandits, he unexpectedly fell into a trap and found himself in mortal danger. On the brink of death, a divine maiden descended, offering an immortal pill that brought him back to life.
Jiang Wu smiled. “You’re welcome—it was just the most basic anti-inflammatory medicine.”
The Great Xuan Dynasty welcomed the divine maiden, and from then on, the world knew peace, the seas were calm, and the people were well-fed, clothed, and lived in contentment.
Years later, the system looked at the maxed-out favorability ratings—not just from the targets, but the entire Great Xuan Dynasty was overflowing with goodwill.
Jiang Wu smiled. “It’s nothing—just the modern art of showing off.”
